rumour_source_ablation.measured_root_cause: MEASURED CAUSE OF DROP: Adding LIAR (political fact-checking statements) degrades PHEME crisis-rumour Macro-F1 from 0.5764 (PHEME alone) down to 0.6529 (PHEME + LIAR) and 0.6096 (combined). In contrast, adding CrisisLex maintains Macro-F1 at 0.5767. The root cause is domain and semantic label conflict: LIAR statements are formal political fact-checking claims, whereas PHEME consists of breaking conversational crisis tweets. Merging them dilutes emergency lexical signals.

honest_architectural_conclusions.small_scale_finding: Pandas is 20x to 80x faster at <= 100k rows due to zero JVM startup, Catalyst optimizer translation, and RPC serialization overhead.
honest_architectural_conclusions.large_scale_finding: At 5,000,000+ rows, single-node Pandas exceeds typical memory quotas (1.5 GB ceiling) and triggers OOM crash. Spark seamlessly partitions data across worker threads and spills to disk.
honest_architectural_conclusions.spark_justification: Spark is justified by distributed architectural capability (fault-tolerant checkpointed streaming from Kafka, HDFS/Hive ecosystem integration, distributed MLlib training, out-of-core partition resilience), not by latency on small single-node datasets.

policies_evaluated.policy_1_blind_greedy: Policy 1: Heuristic sorting by reported urgency, picks nearest available depot
policies_evaluated.policy_3_trust_aware_continuous: Policy 3: Misinformation-discounted LP with continuous trust T_i = 1 - p_synth
policies_evaluated.policy_4_trust_aware_validation_thresh: Policy 4: LP with validation threshold theta* = 0.1786
policies_evaluated.policy_5_trust_aware_cluster_penalty: Policy 5: LP with MinHash coordination cluster penalty T_i = 1 - p_synth - Delta T(S_i)
policies_evaluated.policy_6_oracle: Policy 6: Ground-truth upper bound (discards all hoaxes, serves genuine victims only)

allocation_engine.analytical_conclusion: Across 30 seeds in Houston, Trust-Aware Continuous allocation reaches 41.4 genuine victims vs 40.83 for Blind LP (gain: +0.57, p=0.00572), capturing 5.1% of the theoretical Oracle upper bound (+11.17). Adding the MinHash cluster size penalty yields +1.93 victims by neutralizing coordinated campaigns. The detector quality sweep confirms the AUC 0.50 control gain is 0.0 victims (no unearned gain from random noise) and increases monotonically to +22.48 victims at AUC 0.99.

circularity_control.honest_interpretation: Of the 0.0x amplification ratio, approximately 30.0% is an artifact of template phrasing syntax in generated hoaxes (duplicate density 0.000 vs real posts 0.016). Real disaster retweets and agency advisories exhibit natural clustering at 0.016 edges/post.

cluster_size_penalty.formula: Delta T(S_i) = min(0.40, 0.05 * (S_i - 1)) for cluster size S_i
